meta.note: TAT targets in fractional hours. bql_to_ms and ms_to_md as rates (0.0-1.0) -- used by Control Tower's city funnel breakdown for BQL->MS% and MS->MD% coloring. LRMs inherit their cluster target; omit a cluster to use global. lc_to_first_call is split into working_hours and calendar bases (Referral MOP Aug'26 review) -- index.html's resolveTarget() does not yet read the basis-specific sub-keys, so wire that up before relying on it in the UI. bql_to_ms global/by_cluster values are MS/Leads from the Combined MOP table in Referral MOP Aug'26_Final.xlsx (India row = global).
